race.comment: SIXTY GRAND (1) gets the nod. He won narrowly beaten at Morphettville two starts ago, then was sent out favourite in a BM66 at Mornington and was only beaten a length and a half after beginning slowly and covering ground. The first attempt at 2400m is unknown but the easier grade and 3kg claim give him a strong platform. CALLAWADDA (4) is a danger, with his fourth at Warrnambool building on an Echuca placing and his record around 2400m reading well for this. He'll take holding out. NICOFFHOME (3) rises from a BM56 win at Mornington, where he beat Up And Under by just under two lengths, and his established 2400m record keeps him in the argument despite having been well beaten by SIXTY GRAND two runs ago. MICKIO (2) was narrowly denied in a BM66 at Donald after a few bumps in running and has a Geelong win to his name. This trip is of some concern but he maps for every chance.
